❖ Led the functional and business analysis for various product lines including cash deposit, funds transfer, Business Banking via SCPay,
ATLAS for Hong Kong and Cross border transfer.
❖ Stakeholder collaboration with cross functional teams to gather requirement and document user journey, pain points and functional
specs.
❖ Involved in multiple key banking journeys including Business Banking, Mortgages, Cash operations and WRB Payments- DDA and DDI,
enhancing end to end process efficiency and customer experience.
❖ Actively involved in requirement gathering and analysis for the WRB – DDA/DDI module, focusing on Off-Us and On-Us mandate creation
and verification process using ISO message standards.
❖ Contributed to end-to-end dry run and validation processes ensuring seamless message flow and compliance for ISO 20022 message
including pain.009, pain.010, pain.011, pain.012, pacs.003 and pacs.008.
❖ Collaborated with product teams and stakeholders to gather requirements for user journeys, and participated in dry runs to define and
validate automation scope.
❖ Involved in CASA Management, Payment validations, Report generations, Filtering and Reconciliations with the payment engine as per
the stakeholder requirement.
❖ Validated ATLAS implementation for Hong Kong ensuring accurate mapping of user requirements and system functionality for seamless
integration.
❖ Worked closely with upstream and downstream systems to validate message orchestration, data mapping and reconciliation accuracy.

projects.client: Various TPH Clients – BOE, Open Bank, Citco, K&H, Societe Generale, MUFG, BJB Etc.
details: Key Result Areas:
❖ Led business analysis and testing efforts for SEPA, SWIFT, CBPR+, and Temenos Payments Hub (TPH), managing a cross-functional team
and ensuring delivery of high-quality payment solutions.
❖ Translated business requirements into detailed user stories, use cases, BRDs, and FSDs, driving alignment across development and QA teams.
❖ Conducted grooming sessions to prioritize backlog items, performed root cause analysis, and supported through all QA phases.
❖ Drafted and executed functional test cases for payment message formats, ensuring compliance with ISO20022 standards in the Real-Time
Payments environment.
❖ Facilitated stakeholder workshops, gathered requirements through interviews and focus groups, and executed detailed gap and impact
analyses using UML and data flow diagrams.
❖ Contributed to SEPA- CT/DD, Instant payment flows using ISO 20022 message formats such as pain.001, pain.002, pacs.008, pacs.002,
pacs.004, pacs.028, camt.056, camt.029 and camt.054.
❖ Authored and managed detailed user stories and acceptance criteria in JIRA for payments features such as SEPA Credit Transfer, SWIFT
MT103 processing, and sanctions screening.
❖ Performed techno-functional responsibilities including client-specific configurations, system integration support and in log analysis for
issue recreation.
❖ Involved in ISO 20022 migration from ISO 15022 (MT to MX) and implementation of SEPA Rule book Changes to ensure compliance with
regularity standards.
BNY Mellon Chennai
